question: Can even vast material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
This is posed as a comparison
inference: Even immense wealth, like an ocean of jewels, is not a sufficient reason to give this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
